method: One QR span construction per input/output group from the known rank8 factors, Gaussian completion to the existing d_core, followed by one shared affine-head minimum-change solve. Freeze all task latents, layer embeddings and hidden-network weights. No architecture growth or optimizer sweep.
claim_boundary: Proposed after the fixed-alignment geometry result, before any outcome of this construction.
Privileged adapter-weight reconstruction is a representability witness, not learning from examples or a new continual-learning method.
The original architecture is unchanged; input/output alignments and four shared output heads change. Old tasks are not protected or evaluated.
A single fixed RTE latent must drive the native generator for all sequence ABC examples.
FP64 weight reproduction and FP32 serialized native behavior are distinct checks; behavioral scores are required before claiming skill reproduction.
